workflow: Multiple worker threads use one shared mutable byte sequence during concurrent connection setup.
One thread replaces or updates the sequence while another thread reads it for comparison.
The accesses are unsynchronized, so the reader observes storage being modified concurrently.
Race-detection instrumentation reports the data race and terminates the operation instead of allowing concurrent setup to complete.
summary: Concurrent unsynchronized read and update of shared byte storage
decision_reason: The failure mechanism is materially the same as concurrent unsynchronized reads and writes of shared mutable byte storage; the connection and comparison context are implementation-specific symptoms.
